term.name: regex_cache
term.definition: The compiled regexes of one evaluation, keyed by regex text and regex flags, so fn:matches, fn:replace, fn:tokenize, fn:analyze-string, fn:matching-segments and fn:regex's functions compile a regex once; bounded, the least recently used entry no call is using evicted first, kept in the evaluation memo (internal, src/function_library_regex.c, )
